state and is being actively
developed.](https://www.repostatus.org/badges/latest/active.svg)](https://www.repostatus.org/#active)
[![R-check](https://github.com/ropensci/worrms/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ropensci/worrms/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

downloads](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/worrms)](https://github.com/r-hub/cranlogs.app)

[![cran

`worrms` is a R client for the World Register of Marine Species

- World Register of Marine Species (WoRMS)
  <https://www.marinespecies.org/>
- WoRMS REST API docs: <https://www.marinespecies.org/rest/>

See the taxize book (<https://taxize.dev>) for taxonomically focused
work in this and similar packages.

## Installation

More stable CRAN version

``` R
install.packages("worrms")
```

Development version

``` R
remotes::install_github("ropensci/worrms")

library("worrms")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`wm_attr_aphia()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_attr_aphia.md)
  [`wm_attr_aphia_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_attr_aphia.md)
  : Get AphiaIDs by attribute definition ID
- [`wm_attr_category()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_attr_category.md)
  [`wm_attr_category_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_attr_category.md)
  : Get attributes grouped by a CategoryID
- [`wm_attr_data()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_attr_data.md)
  [`wm_attr_data_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_attr_data.md)
  : Get attribute data by AphiaID
- [`wm_attr_def()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_attr_def.md)
  [`wm_attr_def_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_attr_def.md)
  : Get attribute definition by ID
- [`wm_children()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_children.md)
  [`wm_children_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_children.md)
  : Get children for an AphiaID
- [`wm_classification()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_classification.md)
  [`wm_classification_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_classification.md)
  : Get classification for an AphiaID
- [`wm_common_id()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_common_id.md)
  [`wm_common_id_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_common_id.md)
  : Get vernacular names from an AphiaID
- [`wm_distribution()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_distribution.md)
  [`wm_distribution_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_distribution.md)
  : Get distribution data by AphiaID
- [`wm_external()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_external.md)
  [`wm_external_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_external.md)
  : Get an external ID via an AphiaID
- [`wm_id2name()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_id2name.md)
  [`wm_id2name_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_id2name.md)
  : Get taxonomic name for an AphiaID
- [`wm_name2id()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_name2id.md)
  [`wm_name2id_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_name2id.md)
  : Get AphiaID from a taxonomic name
- [`wm_ranks_id()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_ranks.md)
  [`wm_ranks_name()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_ranks.md)
  : Get taxonomic ranks by their identifier
- [`wm_record()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_record.md)
  [`wm_record_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_record.md)
  : Get complete AphiaRecord for an AphiaID
- [`wm_record_by_external()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_record_by_external.md)
  [`wm_record_by_external_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_record_by_external.md)
  : Get record by external ID
- [`wm_records_common()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_records_common.md)
  [`wm_records_common_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_records_common.md)
  : Get records by vernacular name, optional fuzzy matching
- [`wm_records_date()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_records_date.md)
  : Get records by date
- [`wm_records_name()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_records_name.md)
  : Get records by single name, optional fuzzy matching
- [`wm_records_names()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_records_names.md)
  : Get records for one or more taxonomic name(s)
- [`wm_records_rank()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_records_rank.md)
  : Get AphiaRecords for a given taxonRankID
- [`wm_records_taxamatch()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_records_taxamatch.md)
  : Get records for one or more taxonomic name(s) using the TAXAMATCH
  fuzzy matching algorithm
- [`wm_sources()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_sources.md)
  [`wm_sources_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_sources.md)
  : Get sources for an AphiaID
- [`wm_synonyms()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_synonyms.md)
  [`wm_synonyms_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/wm_synonyms.md)
  : Get synonyms for an AphiaID
- [`worrms-package`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/worrms-package.md)
  [`worrms`](https://docs.ropensci.org/worrms/reference/worrms-package.md)
  : worrms
